# DzProvider

one root component for every concern an application configures.

- **Family:** Providers
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/providers/DzProvider.vue` · types `packages/core/src/providers/DzProvider.types.ts`
- **Install:** `npm i @dzup-ui/core` — then `import { DzProvider } from '@dzup-ui/core'`
- **Entry points:** `@dzup-ui/core`, `@dzup-ui/core/providers`
- **Risk tier:** B · **Status:** experimental

## Props (11)

| Prop | Type | Required | Declared default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaults` | `DzProviderDefaults \| undefined` | no | — | Application-wide prop defaults. |
| `direction` | `DzDirectionPreference \| undefined` | no | — | Writing direction. `'auto'` derives it from the locale. Setting this to `'ltr'` or `'rtl'` overrides the locale, which is what a host embedding an RTL widget in an LTR page needs — the two are genuinely independent, and deriving direction from locale is a default, not a law. |
| `formats` | `DzFormatDefaults \| undefined` | no | — | `Intl` option defaults every `useDzFormats()` call inherits. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | Active BCP-47 tag, e.g. `'ar-EG'`. |
| `messages` | `DzMessages \| undefined` | no | — | Message catalog. **Deep-merges** with an ancestor's rather than replacing it. |
| `motion` | `DzMotionPreference \| undefined` | no | — | Animation policy. `'full'` overrides a user's stated OS preference (ADR-20 §7). |
| `nonce` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | CSP nonce for any `<style>` this library injects at runtime. |
| `portal` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | Where overlays teleport to: a selector, or omitted for `document.body`. |
| `testIdPrefix` | `string \| undefined` | no | — | Shorthand that both **enables** test ids and namespaces them. Enabling is implied because a host that names a prefix has said what it wants; requiring `:test-ids="{ enabled: true, prefix: 'e2e' }"` alongside would make the common case the verbose one. An explicit `testIds.enabled` still wins, so the shorthand can be overruled without being removed. |
| `testIds` | `Partial<DzTestIds> \| undefined` | no | — | Test-id policy: whether they render at all, and under which attribute. |
| `theme` | `DzProviderThemeOptions \| undefined` | no | — | Theme options, or omitted to leave an ancestor's theme in charge. |

## Usage (from `packages/core/stories/providers/DzProvider.stories.ts`, story `Default`)

```vue

      <DzProvider v-bind="args">
        <div class="grid gap-3 max-w-xs rounded border border-[var(--dz-border)] p-4">
          <DzInput model-value="Configured once" />
          <DzButton tone="primary">Save</DzButton>
        </div>
      </DzProvider>
    
```
